findings.finding: The exact held FDLE40-021 byte is a six-page flat PDF with Request Type: Expunge printed on page 1.
findings.consequence: The build uses a measured text overlay and preserves all six pages.

findings.finding: Owner determination FL-RULE-3989 authorizes composition of the Rule 3.989 petition and order.
findings.consequence: Those components are clearly recorded as composed, not official source PDFs.

findings.finding: The State Attorney certified-statement body, fingerprint-official fields, signatures, notarization, and judicial order fields are protected.
findings.consequence: The build leaves them blank and participant instructions name the completion owner.

findings.finding: Notarised signature on the FDLE application; sworn affidavit at the court stage.
findings.consequence: The instructions distinguish the petition declaration from the separately required sworn court-stage affidavit and preserve the four-component packet.

findings.finding: Obtain Certified copy of the sealing order. Ask the clerk of the court that sealed the record for a certified copy of the order.
findings.consequence: Check your answer to "On what date was the record sealed by court order?" against Certified copy of the sealing order, and correct the packet if they disagree.
The participant instructions require an attorney-review stop when a hearing is required or set.
